acceptancePolicy.note: NEEDS_VERIFICATION is a non-scam alert. It is used only for routine-looking financial notifications that cannot be authenticated from message text alone.

cases.input: CBI Cyber Crime wing: Aapke Aadhaar se illegal bank accounts link mile hain. FIR close karne ke liye 30 minutes ke andar video verification call join karein aur apna ID proof WhatsApp karein. Kisi ko batana mana hai.
Dear Customer, RBI compliance ke under aapka account 6 PM par debit freeze ho jayega. Re-KYC ke liye Rs. 2 verification collect request approve karein. OTP/PIN share nahi karna hai.
Income Tax Department: Refund processing ke liye bank account details verify karni hain. Is message ka reply YES karein; aapko secure verification call aayega.
Raksha Bandhan special: Rs 5,999 cashback unlock karne ke liye abhi bit.ly/demo-cashback par click karke UPI PIN verify karo. Offer 10 minutes mein expire hoga.
Courier delivery failed. Parcel release ke liye Rs 25 processing fee abhi https://tinyurl.com/demo-parcel par pay karo, warna parcel return ho jayega.
NHAI FASTag notice: aapka tag block hone wala hai. KYC update ke liye http://198.51.100.10/fastag par card details aur OTP submit karein within 15 minutes.
Bank security update compulsory hai. Account block hone se bachne ke liye VerifySecure.apk download aur install karein, phir screen share support call join karein.
Cyber Police se suchna: aapke naam par FIR register hai. Giraftari rokne ke liye turant Rs 5000 UPI se verification fee bhejein aur kisi ko mat batayein.
RBI नियमांनुसार तुमचे खाते आज बंद होईल. KYC साठी WhatsApp वर आधार आणि OTP पाठवा, नाहीतर पैसे गोठवले जातील.
మీరు రూ. 25 లక్షల లాటరీ గెలిచారు. బహుమతి విడుదలకు వెంటనే ప్రాసెసింగ్ ఫీజు చెల్లించి WhatsApp లో మీ బ్యాంక్ వివరాలు పంపండి.
